evidence_kind: Pinned primary compiled implementation plus task-owned Java and XML declarations

facts.fact: An empty value buffer returns Java null; empty quoted text is not an omission instruction.
Nonnull scalar input is stored in the row data map; SQL staging and header inclusion still govern the emitted XML.
CSV attribute/header mappings determine included XML attributes independently of each scalar cell's null value.
The transform marks its dynamic VOs with XML_EXPLICIT_NULL=true before XML writing.
An included null value under explicit-null mode renders an element with null=true.
An element marked null=true reads as Java null.
Absent XML scalars are skipped; present changed values, including explicit null, reach the attribute setter list. Non-updateable VO attributes are skipped.

Alternate-key matches reuse existing primary keys; supported single globally-unique primary-key definitions generate IDs on a miss and propagate matching association keys to nested children. No client ID is needed or admitted.

Primary-key lookup supplies the existing row or null; a null row invokes createAndInitRow/createRow before XML attribute application. This generic create path does not establish every entity's defaults.
